displayName: Honda Civic Type R EK9 B16B 5Zigen Reference
sourceRecordingPath: Assets/Sounds/Honda/JDM EK9 CIVIC TYPE-R B16B VTEC Exhaust sound  5ZIGEN MIRACLE FIER BALL  ASMR 4K.mp3
notes: Playable engine tone uses idle_0900 as a quiet 10% non-limiter bed, normal_3500 below VTEC, and vtec_6200 above VTEC.
All source WAVs have been manually edited to loop cleanly and should be used as full-file loops.
VTEC handoff is controlled by the vehicle VTEC blend, not by midpoint sample RPM.

Limiter has no dedicated sound file and no redline crossfade; at the actual limiter it forces the vtec_6200 loop at pinned hard-cut pitch, shutters the volume, and only the tachometer needle uses the shared limiter bounce rule.
